title: a to-do app that doesn't guilt trip you
caption:
when your to-do app doesn't guilt trip you for skipping a day 😭

Daily Charm takes nothing away for a day off, and at night it offers to move what's left to tomorrow. Daily Charm is free to start on the App Store (iPhone).

The person in this video is AI-generated.

#gentleproductivity #todolist #dailyplanner #productivity #dailycharm

end.line: Free to start on the App Store
